title: Lattice Field Theory Analysis of the Chiral Heisenberg Model
summary: Motivated by ongoing interest in the universal behaviour of the Hubbard model of spinning electrons on honeycomb and $π$-flux lattices at the semi-metal -- Mott insulator phase transition, we formulate the 3D chiral Heisenberg model, a theory of relativistic fermions in three spacetime dimensions, as a lattice field theory using domain wall fermions. The contact interaction term preserves an SU(2) global symmetry.
